edit.statement: For request H1, the origin returns HTTP 301 with Location /new; with redirect-following enabled and no error, the client’s next request goes to /new.
edit.subject: The path of the next request caused by H1’s redirect
edit.original: For request H1, the origin returns HTTP 301 with Location /new; with redirect-following enabled and no error, the client’s next request goes to /new.
edit.scope: H1 and its one next request only; same host, redirect-following enabled, no errors. Other redirect events follow ordinary Location semantics.
premises: With redirect-following enabled, a client sends its next request to the path given in the 301 response’s Location header.
